title: Non-members
description: Repositories adjacent to the stack that are deliberately not members, each with a reason. Keys are checkout directory names, because that is what the stray scan sees. Recording a repository here is a stronger statement than silence: it says someone looked. A repository in neither this file nor the roster is a named problem rather than a discovery.

reason.description: Why this repository ships nowhere, or why it is not enrolled yet. Long enough to be an argument rather than a label.

retires_when.description: For a repository that exists to be deleted: the checkable condition that ends it. Its absence means the repository is expected to persist.

candidate.description: True when this repository would pass the membership rule and is simply not enrolled yet. A candidate is a decision someone owes, not a settled exclusion.
